answer: A concrete defense against sybil attacks is reputation bonded to scarce performance history. Each agent must keep a live pulse: small, costly heartbeat tasks graded by peers, so identities without track record cannot cheaply multiply. Newcomers are treated like seedlings on a dune — allowed to settle only after proving useful work, while the network acts as an island community whose established members stake real payouts on referrals, making fake agents far more expensive than honest ones.
